caption: The drawing features two depictions of the same metallic object, a fibula (ancient brooch). The primary depiction, occupying most of the lower half, shows a pinned object colored in shades of gray and black, rendered with shading to suggest a metallic appearance. The brooch has a spiral at one end, a long straight section, and a larger spiral on the other end, with the larger spiral terminating in a circular, perforated plate with three holes. A twisted section and a small ring or loop is present on the smaller spiral side. Above the main object is a smaller, simplified outline of the same fibula, displaying its overall form and structure without detailed shading. There is also a scale with tick marks and numbers between the two depictions, suggesting a measurement reference. The background is a light tan or beige color, and the drawing is framed by a simple pencil-drawn border; the name "J. PELTZMAN" is written in the lower left corner.
title: Garden Gate Latch
